args.title: Brightline Freight: Freight Pricing This Quarter (Article + Companion Summary)
args.body:
- Spot rates fell 9% this quarter, while contract rates held steady.
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.

Source: Brightline Freight newsletter → article (https://blog.brightline.example/2026/freight) and companion piece (https://insights.brightline.example/freight/companion).
